boxes.definition: native DZP centroid + 6 A margin; minimum 20 A per axis
6HUP DZP box transferred by gamma2 C->E CA alignment (N=207, RMSD=0.491 A)

ligand.protonation: as-recorded ChEMBL formal charge/tautomer; no pH microstate or tautomer enumeration
ligand.stereochemistry: preserve specified; unspecified remains source-unspecified; one deterministic sampled 3D configuration, not a known stereoisomer or racemate ensemble
ligand.minimization: MMFF94s maxIters2000; no fallback; convergence audited
ligand.pdbqt: Meeko 0.7.1 gasteiger, rigid_macrocycles=True, flexible_amides=False; standard acyclic torsions

receptor.source: archived PDB ATOM selected chains; model1, altloc blank/A, no waters or heteroatoms
receptor.preparation: OpenBabel add hydrogens once, no pH titration, Gasteiger; rigid PDBQT preserved names, default nonpolar-H merging; all-H PDB for PLIP

docking.pose_policy: all returned <=9 per seed, no padding/rerun based on score; denominator actual successfully extracted poses
docking.plip: NOHYDRO=True; NOFIX=True; prepared H retained; raw XML/TXT per pose
docking.policy_revision: All ten drugs newly redocked in common environment; legacy runs historical only, no value matching

schema: union of observed receptor-qualified resolved common residue keys across ten drugs, using archived receptor-specific mapping; retain all observed interaction types; raw unmapped contacts retained separately; no manual residue selection
zero_policy: only when mapping/site existence and successful extraction of all nine poses are audited
missing_policy: NA, no zero imputation; retain mask and counts

representations.A: per-block residue binary any-contact over all observed interaction types (pose union); supplementary typed binary also exported
representations.B: per-block residue any-contact frequency: union of contacting pose IDs / valid pose count, not sum of type frequencies
representations.C: per-block residue x interaction type frequencies plus P/T stacking pose frequencies
representations.D: C plus contact-conditional raw-contact means of centroid distance, angle, offset; units and observation counts retained
representations.E: alpha1 B concatenated with alpha2 B in fixed order, never averaged

primary.pca: center-only frequency features; SVD; no unit variance scaling; zero variance columns excluded with audit; PC signs largest absolute loading positive

pairwise_missing: use jointly observed columns, save feature count and identities; Euclidean sqrt(sum squared differences), no rescaling; cosine NA if zero norm; binary Jaccard NA if empty union
clustering_pca_missing: within each representation use same all-ten-complete columns for all drugs; save exclusions; stop if insufficient variable dimensions; do not cluster an incomplete distance matrix

secondary.D_scaling: z-score each all-ten-complete nonconstant feature; retain raw and missingness outside analysis
secondary.fixed_sensitivity: cosine average-linkage for B/E; alternative cuts k=2 and k=4; report all, never select by annotation
secondary.comparison: adjusted Rand agreement across cuts/metrics where defined; compare pairwise distance ranks; no significance claims

reproducibility_limit: metric/representation sensitivity is not independent docking reproducibility; one legacy seed cannot establish repeatability
heatmaps: drug columns; C residue x interaction type rows; order by corresponding primary B/E dendrogram; no display filter used for primary computations
feature_exploration: export all PCA loadings and cluster mean differences; top ten absolute loadings per PC and ten largest cluster contrasts by deterministic lexical tie break; flag full drug range <=2/9 as small, do not call mechanistic findings
external_annotation_gate: write structural output hash manifest and frozen config hash before any activity/phenotype annotation load; annotation cannot alter clusters/PCA/config
annotation_policy: keep each assay/composition/species/endpoint/unit/relation/document separately; no cross-study pooling; missing matched values NA; retain beta2/beta3 context mismatch; mouse-only verified existing evidence; class labels solely post-freeze overlay
stability: for each of 5 seeds, same feature schema and metrics; compare aggregate distance ranks (Spearman) and k=3 adjusted Rand; all seeds retained
frequency_denominator: actual evaluable poses, up to45; invalid extraction not zero
